Title: Zéjel (Elegía)

In the silence of the night, a mournful melody (aa)
Whispers through the chambers of my heart's decree. (aa)
In this echoing hall, I find myself alone (bbb),
A ghost in time, where once I thrived and sowed.

With every beat that echoes through my chest (bbb),
The memories fade, and the present turns cold. (bbb)
An elegiac dance of shadows, we perform (ccc)
In this theater of life, where love is but a dream. (ccc)

A dance of sorrow, yet within it lies (ccc)
A testament to what once was and may be. (ccc)
Oh, Elegía, you are the silent cries (ccc)
Of hearts that know not where they truly belong. (ccc)
